svg.aria-label: OpenSlime: Claude Code that proves what helps and gets better without getting heavier. Core feature one, the decision ledger: skills, MCP tools and habits scored with and without, plus your decisions versus the AI per decision type. Core feature two, evidence-gated lessons: each lesson is tested by blind A/B on a single-variable challenger and adopted only by you. 0 hooks, 5 commands, 1.4 KB always-on.
